title: Lecturer on Law
bio: Clara Spera is Counsel at Hecker Fink LLP. In addition to her teaching at Harvard Law School, Clara serves as a Lecturer in Law at Columbia Law School. Previously, she was Senior Counsel at the National Women’s Law Center (NWLC), where she helped lead the Abortion Access Legal Defense Fund, provided strategic advice on reproductive […]
